name: catrig-sample
author: MeyerZon
description: Sample mod: a cat rig registered from a DLL. native/mods/catrig-sample (catrig_sample.dll) binds the rig clip RigSampleCatClip to the character entry RigSampleCat with FW_RegisterCatRig; this folder ships the entry, a vanilla control cat and the rig scene. Spawn-only test content.
